opening.skyabyss.title: Between Sky and Abyss
opening.skyabyss.notebook_hint: Hold the notebook and right-click to read it
objective.skyabyss.read_page: Take the torn page, and read it
objective.skyabyss.watch_sky: Explore, and watch the sky at midday
objective.skyabyss.wait_steps: At night, stay by a light and listen
objective.skyabyss.find_isana: Talk to the traveler at the fire
objective.skyabyss.see_whale: Explore; await the sky song next night
objective.skyabyss.wait_whale: At dusk, look up for the stone whale
opening.skyabyss.bone_rumor: A smell of dry stone rides the wind. It comes from the hills to the %s.
opening.skyabyss.bone_far: Far off, the ridge of a hill looks strangely white. It is not a cloud's shadow.
opening.skyabyss.bone_mid: White fragments lie at your feet. ...Too large.
opening.skyabyss.bone_near: The wind has stopped. The hill is not shaped like a hill.
objective.skyabyss.back_return: Return: crouch on a return stone
